# EmptyState

Use this wherever a list, panel or search result has nothing to show.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.EmptyState` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.EmptyState>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.EmptyState>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.EmptyState">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Empty / first-run / no-results block: mascot or icon, title, one line, one action.

## Props (EmptyStateProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `voice` | `'assistant' \| 'aleem' \| 'cory' \| 'neutral'` | assistant: AI spark tile + first-person copy. aleem: AIUX tile. cory: admissions mascot. neutral: icon tile + product copy. @default "cory" |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | Icon for voice="neutral" (e.g. <Icon name="search" />). Ignored for cory. |
| `scene` | `'empty' \| 'search' \| 'error' \| 'offline' \| 'success' \| 'connect' \| 'invite' \| 'launch' \| 'not-found'` | Spot illustration instead of the mascot tile: empty, search, error, offline, success, not-found. Overrides voice art. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | What is empty, as a short statement. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Why, and what fills it. One or two sentences. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | The one primary action that fills the space. |
| `secondaryAction` | `React.ReactNode` | Optional quieter alternative (ghost / secondary). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | sm for list and panel insets. @default "md" |
| `variant` | `'card' \| 'plain'` | card draws a dashed frame; plain is bare. @default "card" |
| `onInk` | `boolean` | On-ink colours for navy panels. @default false |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
